notes.scope: The four recurring special weather rotations. Sunny, day/night, one-off seasonal maps, Admin Abuse, 2D Tuesday, and event overrides are excluded.
notes.rotationPolicy: Describe the repeating base order and 36-hour once-per-four-Wednesdays window without assigning future calendar dates because special events can override rotations.
notes.itemPolicy: Use durable obtainable categories rather than a volatile exhaustive shop inventory or price list.
notes.imagePolicy: Use the exact current source-page cover for each weather row.

item.name: Fall Weather
item.weatherNeed: Jump into a pile of leaves
item.mapChanges: Grass turns orange, trees turn yellow, red, and orange, and leaf piles appear around the map.
item.temporaryShops: Fall Shop near the Pizza Shop
item.obtainableCategories: Pets, toys, pet accessories, vehicles, stroller, and food
item.forecast: Shown as an orange maple leaf on the weather boards.
item.cardSummary: Fall Weather follows Snow for 36 hours, recolors the island, opens the Fall Shop, and activates the leaf-pile pet need.

item.name: Rain Weather
item.mapChanges: The sky darkens, heavy rain falls, and puddles form on the main roads.
item.temporaryShops: Rain Pet Shop, Rain Gift Shop, and Rain Boat Shop near the Camping Shop
item.obtainableCategories: Pets, toys, pet accessories, vehicles, stroller, and food
item.forecast: Shown as a raindrop on the weather boards.
item.cardSummary: Rain Weather follows Fall for 36 hours, brings heavy rain and puddles, opens three rain shops, and activates the puddle pet need.

item.name: Desert Weather
item.weatherNeed: Dive from a diving board into the sea
item.mapChanges: Yellow sand covers the main map, the river dries up, and trees wilt, shed leaves, or become cacti.
item.temporaryShops: Desert Shop in the dried river behind the School
item.obtainableCategories: Pets, toys, pet accessories, vehicles, stroller, and food
item.forecast: Shown as a potted cactus on the weather boards.
item.cardSummary: Desert Weather follows Rain for 36 hours, dries the river and covers the island in sand, opens the Desert Shop, and activates the diving-board pet need.

item.name: Snow Weather
item.mapChanges: Snow falls, grass and trees are covered in snow, and most of the river freezes for ice skating.
item.temporaryShops: Snowy Igloo Shop on the frozen river near the Playground
item.obtainableCategories: Pets, toys, pet accessories, vehicles, stroller, and food
item.forecast: Shown as a snowflake on the weather boards.
item.cardSummary: Snow Weather follows Desert for 36 hours, freezes most of the river, opens the Snowy Igloo Shop, and activates the snowman pet need.
